newsitem.title: CHINA: China approves new $602 million Bohai Bay port.
newsitem.headline: China approves new $602 million Bohai Bay port.

text.p: China's State Council, or cabinet, has approved a 5.0 billion yuan ($602 million) port to be built in Huanghua in northern Hebei province, the China Daily Business Weekly said on Sunday.
The new port on the Bohai Bay would have four mooring points and take seven years to complete, the newspaper said.
The port was part of a huge infrastructure project to improve the transport of coal from resource-rich western regions to the energy-starved east, it said.
A 16.6 billion yuan railway would link Huanghua with the Dongsheng coalfield in central Shaanxi province, it said.
China Shenhua Group Co would be in charge of the construction and operation of the port and would hold public bidding for the building of the facilities, it said. It gave no further details.
